item.title: Kerry Rape and Sexual Abuse Centre closing its X social media account
item.description: Kerry Rape and Sexual Abuse Centre has confirmed it's closing its account on Elon Musk's social media platform, X. It follows criticism of the platform's AI tool, Grok, which has been linked to deep fake images that 'nudifiy' women and children. X's chatbot, Grok, allows users digitally alter images of other people - including children - by undressing them without their permission. item.title: Yellow wind warning issued for Kerry this Sunday
item.description: A Status Yellow Wind warning has been issued for Kerry, as well as six other counties for Sunday evening. The warning for strong and gusty winds comes into effect for Kerry, as well as Clare, Donegal, Galway, Leitrim, Mayo, and Sligo at 4 o'clock on Sunday. It will remain in place until 10pm on Sunday night. Advertisement

item.title: Property firm purchases auctioneers established by the late Jim Finucane
item.description: A property firm has purchased Tralee company Jim Finucane Auctioneers Ltd. The real estate agency was established by the late Mr Finucane in 1997. The former Cathaoirleach of Kerry County Council and Fine Gael councillor passed away in November aged 68. Advertisement Tralee based company, Sherry Fitzgerald Stephenson Crean has purchased the business. item.title: SIPTU vows to protect as many jobs as possible at Kostal Abbeyfeale
item.description: SIPTU is vowing to protect as many jobs as possible at an electronics factory in West Limerick. Management at Kostal in Abbeyfeale confirmed that the manufacturing of On-Board Chargers (OBCs) for electric vehicles will move to China. The German-headquartered company has committed to informing staff of the number of compulsory redundancies early next month (February). item.title: Saka signs new deal
item.description: Bukayo Saka has committed his long term future to Arsenal. The England winger has agreed an extension to his current deal that will run until 2031. Saka came through the club's academy and has scored 77 goals in 290 appearances. item.title: Kerry wins nine awards at this year's Stripe Young Scientist exhibition
item.description: Kerry has won nine awards at this year's Stripe Young Scientist & Technology Exhibition. Overall winner Aoibheann Daly from Mercy Secondary School Mounthawk in Tralee also won the Cubic Connected Intelligence Award for her GlioScope project which helps doctors improve the treatment of brain cancer. It allows doctors to predict what genetic mutation is likely to be present from an MRI scan so they can make quicker treatment decisions and reduce risk for patients.
